included: Every private charter includes an experienced local captain and crew, fishing rods, reels and basic tackle, plus bottled water and soft drinks. Fishing licenses, bait, meals, transportation and fish cleaning are confirmed with you before the trip.

boats.title: 23ft Panga
paras: Boat #1 is a 23-foot fiberglass panga reserved for one or two anglers — the most direct way to fish San José del Cabo on your own private boat. Its wide beam keeps it steady while you cast, and its outboard motor makes quick runs from calm bays to the moderate swells off the coast.

The open deck stays uncluttered, with rod holders, a livewell for bait and an insulated fish box to keep your catch fresh. Simple, practical and easy to fish from, it suits solo anglers, couples and first-timers alike; depending on the season, dorado, yellowtail, snapper or marlin can be on the menu.
highlights: Rugged fiberglass hull with a wide, stable beam
Outboard motor for quick runs to nearby spots
Rod holders, bait livewell and insulated fish box

boats.title: 26ft Super Panga
paras: Boat #2 is a 26-foot super panga for up to three guests — a step up in space from a classic panga while keeping the personal, close-to-the-water feel that many anglers prefer to a large sportfisher.

It is a practical platform for both coastal and offshore fishing around Los Cabos. When weather and sea conditions allow, your captain may head to grounds such as Gordo Banks or Iman Bank and, depending on the season, target yellowfin tuna, dorado (mahi-mahi), wahoo, roosterfish or snapper. Fishing spots are always chosen for safety, current fish activity and your group's preferences.
highlights: More room than a traditional panga
Ideal for couples, friends and small groups

boats.title: 27ft Premium Center Console
paras: Boat #3 is a 27-foot premium center console for up to four guests, built around a balance of sportfishing and comfort. The center-console layout leaves an open deck to move around freely while fighting fish, without the need for a much larger boat.

Comfortable seating and an onboard toilet make it an easy choice for couples, families and small groups who want a little extra comfort on the water. Departing from Puerto Los Cabos Marina, it fishes the Sea of Cortez, where seasonal targets include yellowfin tuna, dorado, wahoo and marlin; techniques and locations follow the weather, the sea and current fish activity.
highlights: Center-console layout with an open fishing deck
Great for couples, families and small groups

boats.title: 30ft Cuddy Cabin
paras: Boat #4 is a 30-foot cuddy cabin for up to six guests that combines open fishing space with a sheltered cabin. Unlike smaller open boats, the cuddy gives your group a protected place to take a break from the sun and wind between bites.

Comfortable seating and an onboard toilet make it a practical option for families and groups of friends who appreciate extra amenities during a day of fishing. It explores the Sea of Cortez from Puerto Los Cabos Marina, with seasonal opportunities for yellowfin tuna, dorado (mahi-mahi), wahoo and marlin; the crew adapts spots and techniques to ocean conditions and your group's wishes.
highlights: Sheltered cuddy cabin out of the sun and wind

boats.title: 38ft Flybridge
paras: Boat #5 is a 38-foot flybridge sportfishing boat for up to eight guests, designed for groups and families who want room to fish and room to relax. Its elevated flybridge sits above a dedicated fishing area, with a sheltered cabin and comfortable seating below.

That layout lets part of the group follow the action while others rest out of the sun — ideal for a full private day with friends or family. When weather and sea conditions permit, trips can explore the Sea of Cortez around Gordo Banks and Iman Bank, with seasonal opportunities for yellowfin tuna, dorado (mahi-mahi), wahoo and marlin.
highlights: Ideal for larger families and groups

boats.title: 31ft Premium Center Console
paras: Boat #6 is a 31-foot premium center console for up to five guests, combining offshore performance with comfort. Twin engines, a shaded T-top, comfortable seating and an onboard toilet make it a strong all-round choice for couples, families and small groups.

Its open deck gives anglers space to work around the boat, whether you are an experienced angler or on your first fishing adventure. Depending on weather, sea conditions and seasonal fish activity, your captain may choose grounds such as Gordo Banks or Iman Bank to target yellowfin tuna, dorado (mahi-mahi), wahoo or marlin.
highlights: Open fishing deck and comfortable seating

boats.title: 29ft Catamaran Center Console
paras: Boat #7 is a 29-foot catamaran center console for up to six guests. Its twin-hull design creates a wide, stable fishing platform — a real alternative to traditional single-hull boats for anglers who want space and steadiness.

Twin outboard engines, comfortable seating and an onboard toilet complete the setup, and the center-console layout gives good access all around the deck when a fish is on. It suits families, groups of friends and keen sportfishing anglers heading into the Sea of Cortez for seasonal yellowfin tuna, dorado (mahi-mahi), wahoo and marlin, with spots chosen by weather, ocean conditions and recent fish activity.

boats.title: 35ft Premium Cuddy Cabin
paras: Boat #8 is a 35-foot premium cuddy cabin for up to eight guests, made for full-day offshore adventures. It pairs a spacious fishing deck with a sheltered cabin, shaded seating and an onboard toilet, so the whole group stays comfortable on longer trips.

Its standout feature is the onboard navigation and fish-finding equipment — GPS, radar and fish-finding electronics — which help the crew read conditions and locate underwater structure and fish activity. From San José del Cabo it reaches offshore grounds in the Sea of Cortez, with seasonal opportunities for yellowfin tuna, dorado (mahi-mahi), wahoo and marlin.

boats.title: 44ft Premium Flybridge
paras: Boat #9 is the 44-foot premium flybridge, one of the largest private charter options at Exotic Fish Cabo, for up to ten guests. Its elevated flybridge offers a higher vantage point to watch the ocean and spot surface activity.

Below, a generous fishing deck gives anglers room to move, while the sheltered cabin, comfortable seating and onboard bathroom offer comfortable spaces to relax between fishing sessions. It is the natural choice for larger private groups who want to combine serious sportfishing with a comfortable day on the water; the crew selects areas according to weather, currents and recent activity for seasonal yellowfin tuna, dorado (mahi-mahi), wahoo and marlin.

boats.title: 37ft Offshore Catamaran
paras: Boat #10 is a 37-foot offshore catamaran for up to six guests, built for anglers who put fishing space and offshore performance first. Its twin-hull design and four outboard engines create a wide, stable and powerful fishing platform.

A spacious open deck leaves room to move while fighting fish, complemented by comfortable seating and advanced navigation electronics. Depending on weather, ocean conditions and seasonal fish activity, trips may run to offshore grounds such as Gordo Banks and Iman Bank in search of yellowfin tuna, dorado (mahi-mahi), wahoo and marlin.
highlights: Twin-hull catamaran with four outboard engines
